## What's new: know what a link will pack, without running it

- **`zone_predict`: what the next link will pull in, without linking.** When your agent asks for it (it never runs on its own), it follows the references the linker follows in your sources (GDT fields, model materials, effects, animation tables, the models and entities placed in your map) and answers three ways:
  - the whole build: assets by type and what each zone line drags in;
  - one zone line or asset, for example `weapon,t9_rpk_up` and everything it brings (771 assets on a real map);
  - why an asset will be packed: the chain from it up to its zone line or the map.
- **It lists referenced assets nothing defines**: a material pointing at an image that isn't there, a weapon naming an effect file that was moved. The link has nothing of yours to pack for them: check the name that references them.
- **It warns before the link when the stock version will replace yours**: your GDT copy of a stock asset that an inherited assetlist still lists, with the line to comment out.
- **Checked against the linker itself**: on a real 23,000-asset map, the prediction contains everything the link actually packed.
- **`zone_check` now catches materials and weapons** among your GDT versions that stock replaces; it used to miss them.
- **The GDT tools know more of APE's fields**: every texture slot of the advanced and emissive material types (no more false "doesn't read colorMap00"), gib models, fxanim animations, body-type lists. `gdt_refs` no longer lists a model through a disabled custom bullet mesh.
